question_text: Define diffusion. Write any two factors that affect it.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Diffusion defined
steps.margin_note: Direction of movement plus the word passive. Four lines.
lines: Diffusion is the movement of molecules from a
region of higher concentration to a region of
It is a passive process and needs no energy.
steps.why: Diffusion is defined by the direction of movement, so the definition has to name both ends of the gradient rather than just say molecules move.
common_mistakes: Saying molecules move from low to high. That is the opposite of diffusion.
Calling it an active process. Diffusion is PASSIVE.
steps.memory_tip: Downhill only: high to low, no energy spent.

steps.label: Two factors that affect it
steps.margin_note: Two named factors, each with its effect on the rate.
lines: molecules move faster, so diffusion is faster.
steps.why: Both named factors change the same thing — how fast molecules cross the gradient — so each one is stated with its effect on the rate.
common_mistakes: Naming a factor without saying what it does to the rate. The effect is the mark.
Naming only one factor. The question asks for two.
steps.memory_tip: Hotter and steeper both mean faster.
